newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-SNAIGE MAKES 400,000 LITAS PROFIT IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-SNAIGE MAKES 400,000 LITAS PROFIT IN MAY.

text.p: Lithuanian fridge producer Snaige said on Friday that it made a 400,000 litas net profit in May compared to 60,000 litas the month before.
The company made losses of 4.2 million litas in the first quarter.
"Our sales in the first five months of the year were 44.7 million litas, slightly lower than 45.6 million litas in the same period of last year," company president Antanas Andrulionis told Reuters.
He also said the company's sales in May rose to 11.7 million litas compared to 11 million litas the month before.
"We usually sell considerably more fridges in the summer and our sales in the next few months will continue to grow," Andrulionis added.

The company has said the summer months may make up for the first quarter losses. When it moves into profit, it plans to call a shareholder meeting to authorise a 20 million litas share capital boost from 40 million litas.
